Quote from: Lexi on June 16, 2009, 09:20:51 PM
drug labs would be abolished and some other form of money printer created. (Perhaps the drug labs could later produce weed in small amounts when the drugs mod is finally done, say about 10% of the yeild of normal weed production, via the same method of this.)
Money printers become containers that can only store money. Money can be removed and money can be placed in, in varying amounts, with a limit of say $500 in each printer. Every contra time, $70 would be placed into the printer's inventory, regardless of how much is already in there. Any money that goes over the $500 limit would be lost. If any money overflows, the printer will instantly jam and will need to be completely emptied before it will start printing again.
If a printer is destroyed it explodes damaging everything near it but does not give any money. The only safe way to destroy a printer is from the other side of the room. printers will not set each other off.
This way, when raiding bases, destroying contra is a counteractive activity, as it'll make an explosion loud enough that half the city can hear it. What you can do though is to wait until the printer jams then remove $499 so the guy is left with $1 when he returns home.
You can also skiv $20 off every transaction if you're looking after a lot of people's printers :3
It's a coming, but I think we need more, so here is where you make any and all suggestions for new contraband. Doesn't matter if, say for instance I already said it was a pile of shit, suggest it again.
It has to follow these guidelines.
  • It works like this:
    • 10: PURCHASE CONTRABAND
    • 20: OPTIONALLY DO SOMETHING LIKE PLACE BATTERIES IN THE CONTRABAND'S INVENTORY
    • 30: WAIT
    • 40: WAIT
    • 50: SOMETHING HAPPENS TO THE CONTRABAND'S INVENTORY, LIKE THE AMOUNT OF MONEY GOING UP OR BATTERIES BEING EATEN
    • 60: OPTIONALLY, SOMETHING ELSE HAPPENS TOO LIKE A CHINESE MAN'S CORPSE APPEARING IN THE MIDDLE OF THE FLOOR
    • 70: GOTO 20
  • All actions regarding the contraband are inventory based (putting in/taking stuff away) so you have to have a supply of batteries to power it rather than pressing 'use 2 refil' etc
  • You are penalised if you ignore it ie the inventory is full and it jams or it runs out of batteries and stops working or it runs out of oil and the cogs rip themselves apart and you have to buy a new one
  • Any effects it has can be felt by anyone, so someone with key access or a lockpick could open it and take out the money, or anyone near it stops feeling hungry or whoever is closest to it when the flux capacitor is fully charged gets 200HP and is set on fire or whatever
  • Any items that the contraband requires like batteries, infected rye, oil, small children etc must have a secondary purpose. For example: batteries give you extra flashlight, infected rye poisons you, oil makes you bleed internally, small children cover you in jam etc
  • There is no benefits to destroying the contraband, other than making it so the owner can't use it
  • The contraband's effects must not damage the server's economy/wellbeing, such as a box you put beans into and out comes tranqs or a machine that constantly churns out $200000 notes at a rate of 1 per minute.
  • Be inventive. Have some kind of a twist to it that isn't just farming.
  • Be sensible
  • the contraband doesn't have to be illegal (making it not exactly contraband)
an example:
A cash register. Money can be put in, and every pay day you get 10% interest. If the amount of money in the cash register exceeds the inventory limit of say $500 on payday, the cash register 'bursts open', with the visible result of the register being unlocked so anyone can reach in and remove as much as they want. This item is legal.
EDIT: Example 2:
A drop box. Anyone can put money in, but money can only be taken out when it is unlocked. Used for fundrasing and such, or for your organisation's contraband farm where you have huge racks of printers each belonging to different people, and The Keeper Of The Drugs goes around removing money from them as it becomes available and drops it into the box below. The owner can them come and retrieve money as applicable.
Your serve, gentlemen.

LEGAL Use of the Printing Press

Printing Newspapers

1. Buy the printing Press from store ($2,000)
2. Buy '10 Sheets of Fine Paper' + '1 Good Quality Ink'.
3. Has 10 charges making $100 per charge.

Profit per 10 Charge cycle: $930

Advantage: More charges until jam so it can be left unmanned for longer.

Printing Criminal Propaganda Letters

3. Has 5 charges making $80 per charge.
4. Jams after 5 charges.

6. Use the printing press.
7. Goto 1. and repeat.

NOTE: 1 Cheap Ink costs $10 + 5 Sheets of Scrap Paper costs $20. Both can be bought from the Supplier (making it a much more worth while class).

Profit per 5 Charge cycle: $370
Compared with Legal Method: $465

You could use this idea for money printers, replace the type of ink + paper. The Black Market Dealer would sell the Blank Notes.

This system could also be used to replace how people make notes. Look at printing press -> type /note message here (you need 1 Cheap Ink and 1 Scrap Paper for a note)

posts.author: PRCheese
posts.title: Re: kontrëbond
posts.html:
Soda Machines
Used publicly, and once placed can only be repositioned using a special item bought from the Supplier.
The Soda Machine supplies Drinks, or A drink, such as Soda. The model for soda will be a can.

The Soda restores 15 hunger (due to thirst not being in the RP), and 15 health (not set on these numbers, they might be a bit too much).
To use the Soda it HAS to be bought from the machine, no other way.

The machine, however, needs to be supplied with soda. The soda supply is sold by either a Supplier or a Pharmacist. The soda supply contains 10 cans and costs 300$, the machine can store up to 100 cans. The supply cannot be opened and is only usable in the machine.

In order to receive the soda, one has to insert an amount of money set by the owner, so clans can have it for, for example, 10 coins, while vendors could have it for 50$, for example.

The machine itself, when it comes to retrieving the money, acts like a door- only the owner of the machine can open it, though it can be lockpicked (not breached, because well, logically that would destroy all the money) to get the funds out. Should have a high amount of health so it'd be hard to destroy, however upon destruction it drops 1-3 cans, if there were more than 3.

posts.html:
Modified Old Idea with Lexi's Help

Printing Press

You will choose on the Printer which type of thing you wish to print, Newspapers or Illegal Propaganda Letters.

It will display on the printer what job it is currently printing. IE. Printing - News Article or Printing - Illegal Propaganda
This makes it possible for people to identify whether it is legal or not.

The time between each sheet of paper being used (each charge) is 1 minute.

LEGAL Use of the Printing Press

Printing Newspapers

1. Buy the printing Press from store ($2,000)

To start printing newspapers you must put a minimum of 5 Sheets Paper and 1 Ink Cartridge in the Press for it to work.
The paper will be used every 1 minute: 5, 4, 3, 2, 1 when the final sheet goes the Ink goes too and $475 is left in the machine.
A maximum of 10 Sheets of paper and 2 Ink Cartridges can be put into the press at one time.
The paper taking away fails if no ink is in the press, and if it runs out of paper it breaks.
To fix a broken Press you use the item 'spanner' and it fixes.
The fixing idea is Lexi's and sounds like an excellent idea to repair broken Contraband.
Model: models/props_lab/reciever_cart.mdl

NOTE: 1 Good Quality Ink costs $30 + 1 Sheet of Fine Paper costs $4. Both can be bought from the Supplier (making it a much more worth while class).

Profit per 10 Charge cycle: $950 - $130 = $820

ILLIGAL Use of the Printing Press

Printing Criminal Propaganda Letters

1. Buy the printing Press from store ($2,000)

To start printing newspapers you must put a minimum of 5 Sheets Paper and 1 Ink Cartridge in the Press for it to work.
The paper will be used every 1 minute: 5, 4, 3, 2, 1 when the final sheet goes the Ink goes too and $600 is left in the machine.
A maximum of 10 Sheets of paper and 2 Ink Cartridges can be put into the press at one time.
The paper taking away fails if no ink is in the press, and if it runs out of paper it breaks.
To fix a broken Press you use the item 'spanner' and it fixes.
The fixing idea is Lexi's and sounds like an excellent idea to repair broken Contraband.
Model: models/props_lab/reciever_cart.mdl

NOTE: Uses same paper as Legal way.

Profit per 10 Charge cycle: $1,200 - $130 = $1,070


You could use this idea for money printers, replace the type of ink + paper. The Black Market Dealer would sell the Blank Notes.

This system could also be used to replace how people make notes. Look at printing press -> type /note message here (you need 1 Cheap Ink and 1 Scrap Paper for a note)

Feel free to use this ideas for Printing Based money making methods.

posts.author: Lexi
posts.title: Re: kontrëbond
posts.html:
addendum to clown's penisidea. Writing notes require you to 'use' a paper, and depending on the quality of paper you use, your note lasts for longer.
Notes now decompose as they get older, reducing note spam such.
While it does matter what kind of paper you use (there's like scrap, basic, fine and calligraphy) to write notes, it doesn't matter what kind you shove in the printer.
To get a printer to print something, you must add an item to it's print queue, which is 2 slots long and has a choice between 'legal' and 'illegal' or such. The printing will start the moment a job is queued, and if there is no paper, the printer will instantly break, so be sure to fill it up first.

Automated illegal transaction maker (patent pending):

Printing Press

LEGAL Use of the Printing Press

Printing Newspapers

1. Buy the printing Press from store ($2,000)
2. Buy '10 Sheets of Fine Paper' + '1 Good Quality Ink'.
3. Has 10 charges making $100 per charge.
4. Jams after 10 charges.
5. Buy '10 Fine Paper' + '1 Good Quality Ink'.
6. Use the printing press.
7. Goto 1. and repeat.

NOTE: 1 Good Quality Ink costs $30 + 10 Sheets of Fine Paper costs $40. Both can be bought from the Supplier (making it a much more worth while class).

Profit per 10 Charge cycle: $930

Advantage: More charges until jam so it can be left unmanned for longer.

ILLIGAL Use of the Printing Press

Printing Criminal Propaganda Letters

1. Buy the printing Press from store ($2,000)
2. Buy '5 Sheets of Scrap Paper' + '1 Cheap Ink'.
3. Has 5 charges making $80 per charge.
4. Jams after 5 charges.
5. Buy '5 Fine Paper' + '1 Cheap Ink'.
6. Use the printing press.
7. Goto 1. and repeat.

NOTE: 1 Cheap Ink costs $10 + 5 Sheets of Scrap Paper costs $20. Both can be bought from the Supplier (making it a much more worth while class).

Profit per 5 Charge cycle: $370
Compared with Legal Method: $465

This system could also be used to replace how people make notes. Look at printing press -> type /note message here (you need 1 Cheap Ink and 1 Scrap Paper for a note)

Feel free to use this ideas for Printing Based money making methods.

posts.title: Re: kontrëbond
posts.html:
Quote from: PRCheese on July 06, 2009, 07:03:45 PM
Soda Machines
Used publicly, and once placed can only be repositioned using a special item bought from the Supplier.
The Soda Machine supplies Drinks, or A drink, such as Soda. The model for soda will be a can.

The Soda restores 15 hunger (due to thirst not being in the RP), and 15 health (not set on these numbers, they might be a bit too much).
To use the Soda it HAS to be bought from the machine, no other way.

The machine, however, needs to be supplied with soda. The soda supply is sold by either a Supplier or a Pharmacist. The soda supply contains 10 cans and costs 300$, the machine can store up to 100 cans. The supply cannot be opened and is only usable in the machine.

In order to receive the soda, one has to insert an amount of money set by the owner, so clans can have it for, for example, 10 coins, while vendors could have it for 50$, for example.

The machine itself, when it comes to retrieving the money, acts like a door- only the owner of the machine can open it, though it can be lockpicked (not breached, because well, logically that would destroy all the money) to get the funds out. Should have a high amount of health so it'd be hard to destroy, however upon destruction it drops 1-3 cans, if there were more than 3.
